newsitem.title: LATVIA: APRIL PPI DOWN 0.1PCT MO/MO, UP 3.5PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: APRIL PPI DOWN 0.1PCT MO/MO, UP 3.5PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Latvia's producer price index fell by 0.1 percent in April on a month-on-month basis for a 5.3
percent year-on-year rise, the country's statistics committee
said on Wednesday.
Latvian PPI (pct change) April 97 March 97 April 96
Month-on-month change -0.1 +0.5 +1.2
Year-on-year change +3.8 +5.0 +15.4
The committee said in a statement that during the year from
April 1996 to April 1997, the quickest rise in prices was in
the quarrying sector, where prices increased 21.5 percent.
It said that during the 12 months, water output,
purification and distribution rose 18.7 percent and in rubber
and plastic products manufacturing by 10.4 percent.
In the foot-wear and bag production sector the price rise
was 9.7 percent and in radio and equipment production it was
8.8 percent.
Between April and March of this year, the fastest price
rise was in publishing, printing and reproduction of recordings
at 1.5 percent and television, radio, and communication
equipment production at 1.4 percent.
